displayName: Microsoft Defender Antivirus Exclusion Added via Command Line

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "cmd.exe", "reg.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Add-MpPreference", "Set-MpPreference", "Windows Defender\\Exclusions")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("ExclusionPath", "ExclusionProcess", "ExclusionExtension", "DisableRealtimeMonitoring", "Exclusions\\Paths")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, ReportId

alertTemplate.title: Microsoft Defender Antivirus Exclusion Added via Command Line
alertTemplate.description: Detects PowerShell Add-MpPreference commands or registry modifications adding exclusions to Microsoft Defender Antivirus, commonly performed by crypted malware loaders to evade scans. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-0843, ISM-1405, ISM-1621. Advisories: acsc-2026-09-08-digital-camouflage-crypters-malware.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Verify whether Microsoft Defender Antivirus Tamper Protection is enabled, remove any unauthorised exclusions, and scan excluded paths for crypted payloads (ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-0843, ISM-1405, ISM-1621; Advisories: acsc-2026-09-08-digital-camouflage-crypters-malware).
